title: Virtual Private Networks Documentation
quotation: PPTP relies upon MS-CHAPv2 which has been completely compromised. Intercepted traffic can be decrypted by a third party 100% of the time, so consider any traffic carried in PPTP unencrypted. Migrate to another VPN type as soon as possible.
originalText:
device that utilizes PPTP is no longer secure.




PPTP relies upon MS-CHAPv2 which has been completely compromised. Intercepted
traffic can be decrypted by a third party 100% of the time, so consider any
traffic carried in PPTP unencrypted. Migrate to another VPN type as soon as
possible. More information on the PPTP security compromise can be found at

https://isc.sans.edu/diary/End+of+Days+for+MS-CHAPv2/13807
 and

https://www.cloudcracker.com/blog/2012/07/29/cracking-ms-chap-v2/
.
